propositions: An LLM prompt document for concurrency-race code-review findings must be authored at src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code-review-concurrency.md, following the Pass-1 specialist overlay pattern used by the security and performance overlays.

The concurrency rubric must enforce a lockset-first quartet discipline: name the concurrency model (threads/async/multiprocessing), flag unlocked-twin accessors that bypass sibling serialization, cite all four race elements (shared resource, ≥2 executors, interleaving window with read+write, concrete harm), and suppress findings only when a guard provably prevents harm.

The prompt must include disposition-aware guard-suppression rules that defer attacker-controlled TOCTOU to 'security' and load-only concurrency harm to 'performance', and instruct the model to emit empty findings as the expected case with criteria: ["concurrency"].
The prompt file is structurally inert until registered by the dependent story 'errable-tricksome-ape', which owns OVERLAY_IDS registration, routing entries, and code-review.yaml dispatch wiring.
